purpose: Remove obsolete retained-only HM2 virtual devices from WB MQTT; never touch current HHM, physical devices, Home Assistant or independent automation
broker_connection: Mosquitto on WB; bridge topic # both also configured to 192.168.30.250
safety_conditions: Verify old wb-rules source files are no longer installed
Verify each target virtual device /meta/driver = wb-rules and is not being actively updated
Delete retained data strictly under /devices/<one exact listed id>/#
If deleted metadata reappears investigate the remote MQTT bridge; do not restart heating merely to clear UI
No physical outputs, WB service restarts, or HA retained data cleared as part of this cleanup
verification: Read-only MQTT SUBSCRIBE on the WB broker for /devices/<exact-id>/meta/driver: 14 absent; /devices/iset_hhm/meta/driver exists and equals wb-rules. This does not prove every historic non-driver retained topic absent; device presence check only.
